_doc: Work package A (Feel): upgrade arrow, perfect rolls, shrines, the fleeing treasure creature and its vault.

upgrade._doc: Item power = sum over all mods of (value / best possible value of that affix at refLevel) x kind weight, plus uniqueBonus for a unique effect. An item is an upgrade when its power beats the equipped one by more than minGain (relative) and at least minAbs.

perfect._doc: A perfect roll is an affix of this tier whose value is at least rangeShare of the way from the lowest to the highest roll.

shrines._effects: stat keys add to the hero's stats (castSpeed, spellDmg, burnDmg, ...). Special keys: goldPct, xpPct, rarityPct (more magic/rare/unique drops), barrierLifePct (extra maximum barrier as % of life, filled on use).

bulwark.name: Bulwark Shrine
bulwark.text: Barrier overcharged: +40% of life as barrier

fortune.name: Shrine of Fortune
fortune.text: Magic, rare and unique items drop 75% more often

treasure._doc: The Coin-Wretch: rare, flees from the hero, escapes after lifetime seconds. Uses the champion rank for life and rewards, times hpMult.
treasure.name: Coin-Wretch

vault._doc: Short state of the current area after a Coin-Wretch dies: waves come denser, do not count towards area progress, and bring chests.
vault.name: Hoard Vault
